limitations: streaming is whole-input/incremental owned-event differential, not adapter-versus-owned. Deterministic adapter_frame fixtures cover that comparison.
ffi checks custom allocator balance and C state safety; callback arguments are not a semantic name oracle.
multibyte exercises conversion fallback, not the native name cache itself.

ASan instruments parser/storage/FFI Rust dependencies and harnesses; do not claim the precompiled standard library or system libraries are instrumented. LeakSanitizer is disabled; custom allocator LIVE assertions remain active.
